subject: Startups
title: Pivot vs. Panic
description: A fast breakdown of Pivot vs. Panic for builders.

hook.text: Not every direction change is a pivot. Some are desperate flailing disguised with a fancy word.

buildup.text: A real pivot is deliberate: the team analyzes data, identifies a new hypothesis, and tests it rigorously.

discovery.text: Panic looks different: the team changes everything randomly, chasing whatever seems hot this week.

twist.text: Some famous 'pivots' were actually panics that got lucky. Survivorship bias hides the thousands that didn't.

climax.text: The test: can you explain why the new direction is better with evidence? If not, you're panicking.

punchline.text: Pivots use data. Panic uses hope.

quiz.question: What separates a real pivot from panic?
